Vendored third-party sources

Only files the F3 build opens are kept. License texts: vendor/CMSIS_5/LICENSE.txt
and vendor/ST_LICENSE.txt.

vendor/CMSIS_5/
  Source:  https://github.com/ARM-software/CMSIS_5 (tag 5.9.0)
  License: Apache-2.0
  Files are byte-identical to that tag.

vendor/STM32F30x_StdPeriph_Driver/ (library V1.2.3, 2015)
vendor/CMSIS_std/Device/ST/STM32F30x/ (device headers V1.2.2, 2015)
  Source:  STM32F30x_DSP_StdPeriph_Lib_V1.2.3 (STSW-STM32108)
           https://www.st.com/en/embedded-software/stsw-stm32108.html
  License: MCD-ST Liberty SW License Agreement V2 (Nov 16th, 2011), named in
           every file header; full text in vendor/ST_LICENSE.txt, copied from
           the agreement PDF at the top level of that package.
  Files are identical to that package (line endings ignored) except:
  src/stm32f30x_rcc.c and src/stm32f30x_hrtim.c add
  __attribute__((fallthrough)); for GCC 13.
  ST's later V1.2.4/V1.3.0 releases use a newer agreement (SLA0044/SLA0048);
  it does not apply to these 2015 files.
